limitations: The seven dragon keys establish boss/key progress, not necessarily individual story quest turn-ins; reported goto skipping prevents auto-completion.
World-boss participation alone does not establish narrative quest completion.
Remaining manual chapters need direct terminal quest or mandatory gate evidence; do not infer from chronology, names or items.
Existing Dragon of Time Chaos saga mapping retained; individual character-page badges are not a complete Book of Lore or quest log.
Legacy tutorial alternatives do not prove the current tutorial.
Some historical Chaos finale routes allow Legends to skip earlier storylines; a finale badge alone must not imply all twelve.
Sepulchure's Original Helm is obtainable from SDKA Gift without completing Mysterious Stranger's Tale.
A primary boss quest does not necessarily prove optional epilogues.

inventoryEvidence.policy: Use exact name and item type, positive ownership only. Book of Lore reward and miscellaneous item exclusions documented by Artix. Verified public snapshot must match any imported badge character; anonymous full snapshots require user confirmation per active snapshot and badge character. No manual progress overwritten. Item absence is not negative evidence.
